title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta3

## Vendor-retained trail field test

This prerelease promotes the proven compressed vendor mowing trail into a bounded runtime field test while keeping existing MQTT session history intact.

### Vendor backbone + live MQTT tail

- Poll `/vehicle/trail/get-path-info-data-compress` every 10 seconds while a mower is active, limited to the current retained task zone set.
- Decode the live Base64/Zstandard/JSON response and retain its per-zone XY geometry in a separate in-memory cache; existing MQTT/session Store files are not replaced or migrated.
- Continue to treat fresh `get-path-info-time` rows as the authority for current-cycle progress/start/end metadata. Compressed trail metadata never overrides fresh per-zone state.
- Suppress retained compressed geometry for a zone when fresh vendor coverage is 0%, preventing old points from reappearing after a reset or map edit.
- Overlay the current retained vendor geometry onto `current_cycle_render` so the companion Map Card can show the cloud-retained trail independently from the live MQTT tail.
- Trim the backend live MQTT trail from the newest matching vendor point forward. Matching searches backward through the MQTT route and uses a small spatial tolerance, so repeated passes prefer the newest plausible match.
- Preserve one matched MQTT anchor point when the vendor catches up completely. This lets the Map Card append browser-live positions received after the latest Map API refresh without resurrecting older MQTT history.
- During zone transitions where no unambiguous active vendor row exists, keep the MQTT trail rather than guessing which zone's retained trail should consume it.

### Debug visibility

The authenticated Map API now includes bounded `vendor_trail_debug` metadata with the vendor revision, point counts, last successful fetch age, active-zone progress, MQTT-tail point count/distance and match distance. These fields are for the 0.4.5 trail investigation and may change before stable.

### Compatibility

- Existing entities, scheduler/gate behavior, map geometry, history storage and the 0.4.5-beta2 vendor-first progress/reset fix are retained.
- Existing MQTT history remains the timestamped/fallback source; this beta does not delete it.
- Pair this prerelease with **Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta1** to see the temporary source-debug view: vendor/current-cycle trail in the configured trail color and MQTT-only live tail in red.
